Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that the director of “The Last Horror Movie” was David Winters based on misleading search snippets, failing to verify by opening authoritative sources and to disambiguate from the similarly titled “The Last Horror Film” (1982) directed by David Winters. The correct director of “The Last Horror Movie” (2003) is Julian Richards, whose birthplace is Newport. This misidentification led the process down the wrong path and produced the incorrect final answer.
